## NewsForge v26.4.2

This release fixes Bloomberg reader-mode image handling and improves reader stability.

### Fixes
- Fixed duplicate Bloomberg hero image appearing in reader mode
- Restored Bloomberg inline article images while keeping hero media excluded
- Hardened reader translation state so stale async updates do not leak back after closing the reader
- Synced popup version display with the manifest version
- Fixed settings page select-arrow styling
- Updated documentation to reflect current supported sites and project structure

### Package
- Chrome extension package: `newsforge-26.4.2.zip`
